description: This file defines a class 'AzureTableStorageClusteringProviderBuilder' that implements clustering provider configurations for Azure Table Storage in an Orleans-based distributed app. It contains methods to configure silo and client builders with Azure Storage options, including reading settings from configuration sections and establishing connections to Azure Storage.

classes.name: AzureTableStorageClusteringProviderBuilder
classes.description: Implements provider builder interfaces for configuring Azure Table Storage clustering using configuration settings for both silo and client builders.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures an ISiloBuilder with Azure Storage clustering options based on provided configuration section.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures an IClientBuilder with Azure Storage clustering options based on provided configuration section.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the silo builder with Azure Storage clustering, setting up TableServiceClient based on config.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the client builder with Azure Storage clustering, setting up TableServiceClient based on config.
